data.action: 躺在图纸上翘着腿看星星
data.description: 【森蚺 · 甲板观星】深夜安静的罗德岛顶层甲板上，森蚺直接四仰八叉地躺在摊开的巨幅机甲设计图纸上，双腿翘在栏杆边缘仰望漫天银河，眼神里充满了对星空的憧憬——「雨林的长者说星星是神明的眼睛……但在我看来，未来我们一定能造出飞向星星的巨大钢铁飞船。」
data.promptProse: Eunectes lies back on an unfolded mecha blueprint across the top deck, legs supported by the railing and one hand behind her head as she studies the Milky Way in wonder. Emerald-and-black evening gown pools around her, metal clasp and pendant chain visible in the overhead view. Starlight softly defines her profile; dim safety lamps reveal blueprint lines and gown folds, leaving deeper shadows between deck panels and the railing posts.
data.title: 森蚺 · 甲板观星
